evidence: Koreas five regional banks (Gyeongnam, Gwangju, Busan, Jeonbuk, Jeju) posted an average delinquency rate of 1.33% at end-Q2 2026, the highest since FSS records began in 2008 (17-year high) — more than 3x the 0.39% average at the five nationwide banks (KB, Shinhan, Hana, Woori, NH). Attributed to high rates plus weak regional SME/self-employed lending. FSS is conducting sector/region-level inspection. — News2day/Newsis/Money Today, late Jul-early Sep 2026
